== Description ==

[[Anthony Howard]] (bottom left, blue shirt, dark beard, watch), [[Brandon Baity]] (center left, olive zip hoodie over beige collar, beard), [[Nathan Russell]] (back center at laptop, dark tee, glasses, receding hair), [[Hayes Hunter]] (right holding phone up, dark grey button-down, grey-streaked beard), and [[Scott Lingrell]] (bottom right taking selfie, white hair, glasses) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 3 October 2025.
